Description: [Bit 0] Reset . When set, this bit will perform Soft IP Reset. Any error status are cleared.  When read, '1' indicates reset-in-progress and '0' indicates reset complete

SIP accelerator status. This 4-bit field is encoded as follows:
0x0: Not Alive
0x1: IDLE (Alive)
0x2: BUSY
0x3: ERROR (ie Error from crypto operation)
0x4: HW_ERROR (ie Error generated by HW)
0x5: SUCCESS
0x6 - 0xF: Reserved
Interrupt Status Register. Writing a 1 to any bit in this register clears the associated interrupt.  These bits are cleared on soft reset.
[Bit 0] Transition_To_Success: This interrupt is asserted when SoftIP accelerator status transitions from BUSY to SUCCESS
[Bit 1] Transition_To_Error: This interrupt is asserted when SoftIP accelerator status transitions to ERROR/PANIC states
[Bit 2] Init Done: This interrupt is asserted when SoftIP accelerator comes out of booting and becomes IDLE.

Interrupt Control Register.
Writing a 1 to any bit in this register enables the associated interrupt.
[Bit 0] Enable Transition_To_Success interrupt
[Bit 1] Enable Transition_To_Error interrupt
[Bit 2] Enable Init Done interrupt

Reports Accelerator_IP_ID
0x0: Reserved
0x1: Altera IP (i.e. Altera “mock-up” IP)
0x2: Xiphera IP
0xFFFF_FFFF: Unknown
All other values are reserved
Report Major, Minor and Revision number of ADS SOF
[Bit 31:24] Major version
[Bit 23:12] Minor version
[Bit 11:0] Revision
Report cryptographic algorithm(s) supported

Command register

Bits 15:0 of this register contains the command.
0x0: Host ACK (Host will send this after host has evacuated value held in STATUS.  Will set STATUS back to IDLE.
0x0101: ML-DSA_Verify_Internal
0x0102: PreHash_ML-DSA_Verify
0x0103: Pure_MLDSA_Verify
0xF001: Clear all internal memories and registers.
All other values are reserved.
Base address of SoftIP Accelerator parameters memory.   Sets a 1024-byte window for host to access the parameters memory space.  Parameters are accessed by host via HCI_PARAMETER_DATA.

[17:0] Base address of a 1024-byte window for host to access 256K of memory space (ex: SRAM). Memory is accessed via HCI_PARAM_MEM_DATA. LSBs [9:0] are ignored as the address must be 1024-byte aligned.   Valid values are 0x00000 - 0x3FC00.
